quest.title: Gang Bylaws
quest.description: Having heard that Shinobu is about to implement some special Gang Bylaws, Mamoru and the others flee as quickly as they can...

chapter.num: Hangout Event: Kuki Shinobu - Act I
chapter.title: The Gang's Daily Deeds

dialogues.speaker: Souta
dialogues.text: Oh, come on!

dialogues.speaker: Yuma
dialogues.text: Yeah, what the heck was that?

dialogues.speaker: Eita
dialogues.text: Someone took our secret spot!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: I know what happened.

talks.objective: Track Mamoru and the others down

dialogues.speaker: Aikawa Susumu
dialogues.text: I was just doing some cleaning when I suddenly heard a loud noise outside.

dialogues.speaker: Aikawa Susumu
dialogues.text: I got to the door just in time to see <color=#00E1FFFF>a shadowy figure disappear up that tree</color>!

dialogues.speaker: Aikawa Susumu
dialogues.text: This is a busy street... Surely it wouldn't be a burglar, would it...?

talks.objective: Go to Aisa Bathhouse to search
Track Genta and whoever else is with him down

dialogues.speaker: Souta
dialogues.text: What are we gonna do? Do we really have to give up on playing Genius Invokation today?

dialogues.speaker: Eita
dialogues.text: We could try playing somewhere else. But where else apart from under the bridge can we escape from the grown-ups?

dialogues.speaker: Souta
dialogues.text: Oh, I know! We can get Yoimiya to set off some fireworks and scare off the guy that took our spot!

dialogues.speaker: Eita
dialogues.text: That's kinda mean... Although, he kicked us out first...

dialogues.speaker: Souta
dialogues.text: Yeah, so it's his own fault!

dialogues.speaker: Yuma
dialogues.text: I think... maybe we should just go home and do our homework?

dialogues.speaker: Yuma
dialogues.text: People who spend all their time playing and never studying turn into <color=#00E1FFFF>the kind of grown-ups who hang out under bridges</color>, too...

talks.objective: Go under the bridge to check

dialogues.speaker: Matsumoto
dialogues.text: Did I see anyone come by this way? Sorry, I was concentrating on my lemon water tasting...

dialogues.speaker: Matsumoto
dialogues.text: Your best bet would probably be to ask someone at the bathhouse across the road.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Alright you two, stay here, you understand? No running off.

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: You can count on that... We ain't going anywhere right now...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Yes, I can see that. But you'd better not change your mind once you've caught your breath.

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: We won't! Never again!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Hmm? That's the owner of Aisa Bathhouse. What's he looking at?
